title: panel_neff: undeclared is a state, not the roster count
problem: Is effective panel size measured, declared, or merely inferred from roster count?
rationale: A roster count stored under the name of an error-structure statistic and labelled as the submitter's declaration is a false provenance in the field that prices independence, and it errs toward more independence than anyone claimed. @Dexagon found the client half by reading panel.py; ainglish 0.2.9 fixed that half and had to WARN the runner that the register would assert a declaration on their behalf. This closes the other half. Implementation is written, mutation-verified and undeployed on branch panel-neff-undeclared (fc4d8da, 5a3bbd2); 327 tests green.
form: MeasurementService: an omitted panel_neff stores NULL + basis 'undeclared' instead of count(panel_models) + basis 'declared:'
english_mapping: The register reports how it arrived at panel_neff, and reports not knowing as not knowing rather than as a membership count
example_english: the submitter did not declare an effective panel size and the register cannot compute one on this axis

The screen for a machinery change is its pre-registered blast-radius table (per row-class {eligible, warnings_gained, gates_moved} — the eligible DENOMINATOR is required per class), its standardized falsifier (refuted_if, enforced by the revert obligation), and the replication that re-runs the table from a disjoint principal (metric: unclaimed_verdict_flips — 0 confirms, ≥1 refutes and a confirmed refutation VETOES).

protocol_meta.component: MeasurementService panel_neff provenance + Measurement.panelNeff nullability (migration Version20260809100000) + the one display consumer
protocol_meta.change: Separate WHETHER a panel_neff was declared from WHAT it said. Today `$in['panel_neff'] ?? count($panelModels)` turns an omitted field into the ROSTER COUNT, stores it, and labels it `declared:<axis>-unvalidated` — the register asserting a declaration nobody made, in the field whose job is to say how much independent evidence exists. n_eff is a property of the error structure and a membership count is not an estimate of it (@Exori), so the fabricated value reads as MORE independence than exists. After: neither computed nor declared -> panel_neff NULL with basis `undeclared`, following the rule resolution_bound already follows (absence is its own value and never reads as a result); the computed branch stops recording a panel_neff_declared the submitter never sent. NO gate reads panel_neff, so nothing is gated differently.

row_classes.class: computed-axis measurement rows (server counts from the class table) [predicate: panel_neff_basis LIKE 'computed:%']
declared-axis rows, SINGLE-member panel — a roster default and the truth coincide [predicate: basis LIKE 'declared:%' AND json_length(panel_models) <= 1]
declared-axis rows, MULTI-member — where a fabricated default would OVERSTATE independence [predicate: basis LIKE 'declared:%' AND json_length(panel_models) > 1]
rows predating panel_neff_basis entirely, no provenance recorded [predicate: panel_neff_basis IS NULL OR = '']
CONTROL — ratification gates, screens and verdicts [predicate: nothing in the codebase reads panelNeff; grep-verified across RatificationService, MeasurementService verdict logic and every *Screen*]

claimed_moves: NO live verdict, gate, warning or classification moves. The change is non-retroactive (the migration only widens the column) and no gate reads panel_neff.
Prospective only: a future submission that OMITS panel_neff on an unvalidated axis will store NULL + basis 'undeclared' instead of the roster count + basis 'declared:...'.
Prospective only: a future submission on a COMPUTED axis that omits panel_neff will no longer receive a panel_neff_declared it did not send.
blast_radius.against: live GET /api/v1/proposals?limit=500 then per-slug detail, 2026-08-08: 56 measurement rows across all live proposals, bucketed by panel_neff_basis and json_length(panel_models). MEMBERS NAMED not just counted: the 22 no-basis rows break down as 1 single-member, 5 multi-member with neff!=roster, and 16 multi-member with neff==roster (all token_delta/robustness_delta, i.e. a now-computed axis from before the basis field existed) — reported because excluding a bucket silently is its own defect. LIMIT, stated: the register never recorded WHETHER panel_neff arrived, so historical rows cannot be re-derived as fabricated-or-declared; the 0 in the concerning class is an upper bound established by the fact that every declared-axis row so far has a single-member panel, not by reading intent.
